doc.title: Scott Jimmy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Big Maybelle
summary: He and Maybelle both came from Cleveland; she was like a little sister, harmed by her boyfriend and drugs.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: Let’s talk about a couple of those artists in that period that you hooked up with, like Big Maybelle and Little Esther.
Larry Darnell. Remember that one? Larry Darnell was one of his hits.
Tell me a little bit about your relationship with Big Maybelle, because the idea . . .
Maybelle and I both came from Cleveland, and we worked around together before he even got to know her.

We worked various cities and other clubs. She was like a little sister to me. [?]. She just had a bad situation, like myself. I didn’t have anyone handling the business for me, and Maybelle didn’t have any. She had a boyfriend that she went with. He wasn’t

doing anything right for her. He was letting her get that junk. I always felt that was a rough thing for her. Then she was big and fat and then using that dope. Hey. It wasn’t going to be too long. That’s what happened.
But she was your close personal friend, and you loved hanging out with her.
Oh yeah. She’s my girl, yes.
